text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy ran with all her might in the 
Teio Sho. The day her "ambition" would be 
fulfilled drew closer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
News websites seem to be spreading 
"notorious" rumors about me, calling me 
things like 'The Beast of the Dirt.' I 
suppose I'll just have to show them even 
more terror.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Champions Cup. 
Winning a central GI with massive crowds 
will surely draw even more attention than 
before.
